source_text: Zorvo costs 47 rupees today, and the family pack costs 149 rupees. Call 9876543210 before 12 May 2027. Each bottle contains 2.5 litres, with a 25 percent discount. Kal order bhej dena, and we will confirm tomorrow. The shop opened at 9 am and closes at 8 pm. Our first order was 300 bottles, followed by 425 more. We had to break the ice with a new supplier.
